payload._note: RadNet operates 366 diagnostic imaging centers (as of December 31, 2023) across Arizona, California, Delaware, Florida, Maryland, New Jersey, and New York. However, this 10-K does not disclose a facility roster with individual facility names, addresses, or CMS Certification Numbers (CCNs). The filing describes the business as operating 'freestanding, fixed-site outpatient diagnostic imaging centers' providing MRI, CT, PET, nuclear medicine, mammography, ultrasound, X-ray, and fluoroscopy services. The company also has subsidiaries including eRad Inc. (imaging software), DeepHealth Inc., Aidence Holding B.V., and Quantib B.V. (AI divisions), Heart & Lung Imaging Limited (UK teleradiology), and consolidated medical groups (VIEs) in multiple states. Two specific acquisitions are mentioned: Houston Medical Imaging LLC (7 centers in Houston, TX acquired Feb 2023) and Antelope Valley Outpatient Imaging Center LLC (4 centers in Palmdale, CA acquired Feb 2024). The Item 2 Properties section states 366 centers are leased (not owned) but provides no facility-level detail. Total square footage is ~2.7 million across all leased properties. No CCNs are disclosed in this filing. Individual facility identification would require supplemental schedules not included in this excerpt or external POS file lookup by facility name/location.
